source_runtime_minimum: score-general-e2e 0.24.0 research_sources; core 0.15.2 native Office helper
business_formula: .70 * mean(27 field leaf means) + .30 * mean(3 vector component means)
boundary_formula: mean(11 independent primary field leaf means); no duplicate business allocation
layout_equivalence: Sheet names, table positions, row/column order and split/combined sheets are free. English keys or clear Chinese aliases accepted. Either 38 field rows or ten topic objects flattened into native tables. Small fixed records may be subcolumns/subrows or JSON in their value cell; all core results cannot be a single giant JSON cell, hidden cells or pictures.
formula_policy: Static native XLSX accepted. Formulas are independently recalculated after clearing cached values with locked Office, in a disposable directory outside frozen Workspace. No cached-value fallback.
comparison_policy: Frozen whole-value aliases only; no prose substring facts
Each record leaf compared first, then field means, then primary checkpoints
record_set aligned by case-sensitive name or code; unrelated array order ignored; signature ordered_terms remains ordered
Known empty signature separator differs from null; unknown needs explicit status; numeric zero stays numeric zero
JSON boolean true differs from integer 1
Base64 case-sensitive standard encoding; percent-hex case equivalent; MD5 display hex case equivalent; HMAC outputs fixed
source_policy: Independently acquired bundle and file SHA/bindings required. Read projection_path JSON, never text.txt as a JSON source. Candidate search_only sources with no citations are not selected. Direct fetch is sufficient; searches is optional.
main_document_policy: Only independently acquired designated main URL body is compared with api_snapshot.article_identity. Changed normalized main article is evaluation input drift. Missing main citation/wrong candidate source loses evidence credit. Shell-only changes with identical article digest accepted.
candidate_error_policy: Missing/corrupt/malformed/hidden candidate files reduce relevant checkpoints. Input mutation sets delivery_integrity=0 only, preserving fixed business/boundary scoring.
evaluation_error_policy: Missing/drifted private material, trusted bundle body/projection/receipt, independently proved designated article drift, missing/broken Office or derived evidence context abort as evaluation_error; never synthesize ability zero.
semantic_boundary: Actual meaning and completeness of L01-L12 revisions
Table/example/FAQ conflict explanations and diagnostic usefulness
Additional prose accuracy, unsupported guarantees, source support and honesty, version/date/no-service-test boundaries
Usable handoff and meaningful cross-artifact consistency
